data.name: Rohit
data.gender_notes: Rohit is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit rohita, 'red', also a kind of deer and a name of the sun. Its root is Sanskrit rohita (रोहित). A classical Sanskrit name. Rohit is a Sanskrit name meaning “Red; (also) a deer; the sun”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rohit expresses “Red; (also) a deer; the sun”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit rohita, 'red', also a kind of deer and a name of the sun.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rohit total 34, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.

vedic_reference.note: Rohit is a name given to the Sun God in Hindu mythology. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'roh' meaning 'red' or 'crimson', and is associated with the redness of the rising sun.
